descFull: Kumoss is a developer-first assistant and harness for day-2 cloud infrastructure. It turns intent into plan-validated Terraform/OpenTofu pull requests, transparent drift correction, OPA policy checks, and human review. Multiprovider and interoperable with your existing LLMs, and infrastructure ecosystem.
